title: How to: do it, watch it, say how it went, the bar's icons, and a scan from any screen
why: Coach Milan 19 November 17:31 to 17:43: the home page videos inside the app, in How to, the beta testers' happy paths; one scenario with the long press on Plate; icons like the bar's. 18:08: New at the top right. 18:17: it is not about trying, it is doing it; and feedback, a scale plus free text. 18:25: smiley faces instead of numbers, yes, as line faces. 18:40: colour on the chosen face only, from the five steps. 18:44: a block with all five in colour; only the face coloured, not the whole area. 18:51: the face itself filled with colour, like the emoji; the block on the board and the app the same.

opportunity.from: Coach Milan, 19 November 2026, 17:31 and 17:43. The twelve videos are on 0.3.165, and How to holds eight situations as steps in words.
opportunity.job: As a beta tester, see a path once before I try it, and find the paths the app has that I would not guess.
opportunity.kind: Missing: a path in words only is slow to follow, the long press on Plate is in no situation, and the emoji icons look like no other part of the app.
opportunity.why_now: The videos are new and recorded on today's app; How to is what the beta testers use.

problem: How to describes each situation in four or five steps of words. A tester reads them, then tries. Three of the paths already exist as videos on the home page, but the app does not show them. Holding Plate in the bar opens the camera from any screen (DT309), and no situation tells a tester it exists. The situations carry emoji icons, while the bar and the rest of the app use line icons. The words speak of trying (Try it, Tried it, 1 of 8 tried), while a tester is asked to do the thing in their own day. Tried it says only that, and Coach Milan learns nothing of how it went unless it failed.
story: When I open a situation in How to, I want to see it done once, do it in my own day, and say how it went, so that I do it the way it works and Coach Milan knows how it went.

ac.title: Icons like the bar's
ac.text: Given How to, when I see the list or open a situation, then each situation has a line icon on the tint of the bar's chosen tab, and no emoji: the icons in the table on this board.

ac.title: A row says Video
ac.text: Given a situation that has a video, when I see the list, then its row says Video under its title.

ac.title: Watch it
ac.text: Given I opened a situation with a video, when I tap Watch it, then its video plays in place from the start, with its controls, and nothing of it loads before the tap.

ac.title: A video of part of the path
ac.text: Given I ate something: log it with a photo, when its video plays, then the line under it says The video shows steps 1 to 3.

ac.title: The home page's videos
ac.text: Given I ate something, Cook hands free and A recipe in another language, when their videos play, then they are the home page's meal, cook and languages videos, the same files.

ac.title: Scan a pack from any screen
ac.text: Given How to, when I open Scan a pack from any screen, then it says its four steps, Try it opens the camera's modes as holding Plate does, and Watch it plays its video: Plate held in the bar, the camera's modes, Barcode, the code read, the food on the plate.

ac.title: Its video under the rules
ac.text: Given the videos are recorded, when the recording ends, then the new video of the long press passed HC1 to HC13 with the others, and it is not on the home page.

ac.title: Nine to try
ac.text: Given the beta box at the top of How to, when I read it, then it counts nine situations, and Coach Milan's list of testers counts nine.

ac.title: In three languages
ac.text: Given the new lines, when the app is in Serbian or German, then each shows in that language.

ac.title: New at the top right
ac.text: Given a situation added in the last 14 days, when I see the list, then New sits at the top right of its card, and Tried or Didn't work, once marked, sits under New.

ac.title: Doing, not trying
ac.text: Given How to, when I read it, then it speaks of doing: Beta: 1 of 9 done, Do it now, I did it, Done, and Coach Milan's list says done, as in the table on this board.

ac.title: How did it go?
ac.text: Given I opened a situation, when I tap I did it, then How did it go? shows five line faces from the bar's icon set, from Frown (1, hard) on the left to Laugh (5, easy) on the right, each with its spoken name, and a line of my own that I may leave empty; Send stays off until I choose a face.

ac.title: What I said
ac.text: Given I sent the fourth face and a line, when I open the situation again, then I did it is on and under it the face, You said 4 of 5 and my line; a tap on I did it takes the mark off as today.

ac.title: Coach Milan sees it
ac.text: Given a tester sent the fourth face and a line, when Coach Milan opens that tester under Clients, then the situation says Done, the day, the face with 4 of 5, and the line.

ac.title: The faces in colour
ac.text: Given How did it go?, when I see the five faces, then each is drawn like an emoji: the round face filled with its colour, red, amber, blue, green, dark green from hard to easy, eyes and mouth in ink; the face I choose gets a border in its colour; the face under I did it and in Coach Milan's list is drawn the same.

unchanged: The other situations' words and steps, Try it, Tried it, Didn't work and the note to Coach Milan.
The home page and its twelve videos.
The long press on Plate itself (DT309).
short: How to gets Watch it on three situations, line icons as the bar's, and a ninth situation: Scan a pack from any screen

now: Eight situations in words, each with an emoji. Try it, then Tried it or Didn't work; a note only when it did not work. No video. The long press on Plate is in none of them.
proposed: Line icons from the bar's set on the tint of its chosen tab. Watch it with the home page's video on three situations. A ninth situation, Scan a pack from any screen, with a new video of the long press. Words of doing: Do it now, I did it, Done. I did it asks How did it go?, five line faces from hard to easy, and a line of your own; Coach Milan sees both. New at the top right of the card.
decision: Open. Drawn for Coach Milan's Go, with his 18:08 and 18:17 changes.
details: The pictures on this board are the real app: today's 0.3.165, and a scratch build of it with the icons, Watch it and the new situation, not committed. The long press picture is the app as it is (DT309).
The new video of the long press is not recorded yet: with the Go it is recorded by scripts/record-home-clips.cjs under HC1 to HC13, as way-hold, and goes on no page but How to.
Later, as their own ticket: videos for the other five situations.
In the build (0.3.166) the new situation's line and steps 2 and 3 name the small menu above Plate, as the long press shows it (DT309); the board's first words said the camera opens with its modes.
